title.narrative: Phase III: Strengthening Resilience through Enhancing Health Service Facilities in Yemen

description.narrative: With the support from the Federal Republic of Germany, through the KfW Development Bank, UNOPS works to support 19 health facilities and 21 isolation units that are being rehabilitated as part of the “Strengthening Resilience through enhancing Health Service Facilities in Yemen” project.\nThe project aims at supporting the local health service providers and local communities in increasing access to primary and secondary health facilities. Through restoring the physical infrastructure of the targeted health facilities, providing medical equipment and furniture, and building the capacity of the health staff, UNOPS contributes to the health sector in Yemen for improved healthcare services to the targeted populations.\n
